formulas.ascii: Unit current enters at the source s and leaves at the sink t, held at potential 0. Potentials solve the grounded conductance Laplacian by Jacobi-preconditioned conjugate gradients; the effective resistance is the source potential and the node current is half the summed absolute branch currents plus the injection.
